StatusRule.alternateForm: No armor penalty to spellcasting; no vocalization needed.
StatusRule.beastForm: +2 Strength modifier; only Lykant speech, no Truespeech/Spiritualism/Magitech.
StatusRule.blind: −4 to action checks; everyone counts as invisible.
StatusRule.cursed: Under a curse (only curse removal ends it).
StatusRule.deaf: Penalties to hearing checks; resists spellsongs.
StatusRule.engaged: Engaged in a skirmish: cannot move freely.
StatusRule.entangled: Cannot move; escape with a de-bonding check (Adv. level + STR mod vs. TN).
StatusRule.fullMove: −4 to Evasion until the start of the next turn.
StatusRule.hungry: −1 to all checks and −1 max HP/MP per missed day.
StatusRule.invisible: Attacks against it −4; its attacks impose −4 on Evasion.
StatusRule.petrifying: Ability score reduced step by step; petrified at 0.
StatusRule.prone: −2 to action checks. Standing up is a Minor Action.
StatusRule.sleep: Cannot act; −4 to checks if forced. Ends when touched (Psychic, weak).
StatusRule.stoodUp: −2 to action checks until the end of the turn.
StatusRule.surprised: No combat preparation; −2 to all checks until the next turn.
StatusRule.unconscious: HP 0 or less: cannot act; Death Check when HP drops and every 10 minutes.
StatusRule.underwater: −4 to action checks, ¼ movement, no ranged attacks.
StatusRule.waistDeep: −2 to action checks, half movement, no full move.
StatusRule.weakPoint: Attacks use the monster's weak point bonus.
StatusRule.withdrawing: −4 to Evasion until the start of the next turn.
